Strategic Response to GDFLO

GDFLO has captured 18% of the Argentine market. How should Maipú respond?

Build, Buy, or Partner

Maipú needs 3 digital capabilities. For each one, decide the acquisition strategy:

1. IoT Sensors for Installed Equipment

Hardware + connectivity to monitor 12,000 installed units across 340 clients.

Build: ARS 4.2B / 24 months / requires hiring 30 IoT engineers
Buy: ARS 2.8B / 8 months / import from Bosch IoT (subject to BCRA restrictions)
Partner: ARS 1.5B/year / 4 months / local partner TechBA S.A. integrates sensors

2. Analytics Platform

Software to process sensor data, generate predictive alerts, and produce the client dashboard.

Build: ARS 6.5B / 30 months / requires hiring 50 data engineers and scientists
Buy: ARS 8.0B / 6 months / acquire DataSur S.A. (Buenos Aires analytics startup)
Partner: ARS 2.2B/year / 5 months / partner with Microsoft Azure IoT + local integrator

3. Outcome-Based Pricing Model

Design the pricing structure, contractual framework, and risk model for pay-per-performance contracts.

Build: ARS 1.8B / 12 months / internal team with 2 external consultants
Buy: ARS 3.5B / 4 months / acquire niche consulting firm with SaaS pricing IP
Partner: ARS 0.9B/year / 6 months / partner with McKinsey Digital practice in Buenos Aires

BCRA Import Restriction

The CFO reports: BCRA has reduced the dollar quota for tech imports (Comunicación A7622). This impacts imported IoT hardware. How do you adjust?

Organizational Resistance

The CDO has presented the Digital Transformation Plan. Three resistance points have emerged simultaneously:

VP Sales — Carlos Vidaña

"If clients can monitor their equipment via a dashboard, why do they need my team? My 80 technical salespeople will lose 60% of their client interactions. And my commission drops from ARS 8.5M per equipment sale to ARS 100K/month on a subscription."

VP Engineering — Patricia Llorente

"If we install sensors that report in real time to clients, what happens when the sensor detects a design flaw in our pump before we detect it ourselves? We are putting transparency on data that hurts us."

Distributor Network (47 regional distributors — 38% of sales)

The direct digital channel to clients threatens to disintermediate the distributor network that generates 38% of revenue.
